menus.title: Menu Management
menus.name: Name
menus.menu_type_directory_hint: A directory is a pure navigation grouping with no page of its own — path, component, and permission don't apply.
menus.permission_derived_none: Blank — can't derive a codename without a path
menus.permission_mismatch_warning: "{{codename}}" doesn't match a real permission — this won't resolve if something starts checking it
menus.roles_empty_hint: Empty = public, visible to every role — not "nobody"
menus.visible_hint: Separate from Active. An active-but-hidden entry still opens via direct navigation — it's just absent from the sidebar list.
menus.active_hint: Query-level gate: a non-ADMIN user never sees an inactive menu at all — it's filtered out of their tree entirely, not greyed out.
menus.icon_required_hint: Required. In locales where the name renders in Chinese (untranslated database content), the icon is the only way to tell entries apart.
menus.icon_collision_warning: Already used by "{{name}}" under the same parent
menus.gates_intro: An entry can be invisible for five unrelated reasons. This is which one is in force.
menus.gate_is_active_effect: Query-level gate. A non-ADMIN's request filters is_active=True before it reaches them — an inactive entry is absent from their tree, not dimmed.
menus.gate_is_active_nonadmin: Read-only, no toggle shown — and even a role granted write access couldn't find an inactive row here, since their own reads filter it out too.
menus.gate_visible_effect: Sidebar-only. An invisible-but-active entry still resolves via direct navigation — only the sidebar listing skips it.
menus.gate_visible_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gate_permission_effect: The codename Menu.get_codename() would use if anything called it — nothing does yet, so this is dormant, not a live gate. Blank derives a guess from path.
menus.gate_permission_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gate_roles_effect: Coarser than permission — controls which roles see this entry at all. Empty list = public, not "nobody".
menus.gate_roles_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gate_menu_type_effect: DIRECTORY / MENU / BUTTON. Decides which of the other fields are meaningful — a DIRECTORY has no page.
menus.gate_menu_type_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gates_footnote: All five require menu.manage to edit at all — ADMIN-only in the current role setup.
menus.delete_confirm_message: "{{name}}" will move to the recycle bin. It can be restored for {{days}} days; after that, an administrator can permanently delete it.

matrix.title: Permission Matrix
matrix.legend_intro: Holding more codenames does not mean outranking another role. Real comparisons pulled from the current data:
matrix.legend_nonsubset: {{roleA}} holds codenames {{roleB}} does not (e.g. {{codenamesA}}); {{roleB}} likewise holds codenames {{roleA}} does not (e.g. {{codenamesB}}) — neither is a subset of the other.
matrix.legend_countparadox: {{higher}} holds {{higherCount}} codenames in total, more than {{lower}}'s {{lowerCount}} — yet {{lower}} alone holds {{codenames}}, which {{higher}} does not. Holding more does not mean holding a superset.
matrix.confirm_replace_notice: This endpoint replaces the whole set: saving deletes every grant the roles below currently hold, then rebuilds from the result shown here.
matrix.confirm_user_count: {{count}} user(s) currently hold this role — this takes effect immediately on save.
matrix.confirm_clear_warning: This clears every codename {{role}} currently holds.
matrix.confirm_menu_read_warning: menu.read is among what's being removed — holders of this role will see an empty navigation tree on their next login.
